title: Paris in the Spring
question: At what time of year did Ken visit Paris?

meanings.usage: 指放映电影的场所，英式英语常用，美语多用movie theater
一年四季之一，通常指3月到5月
形容景色、人物或事物外观优美
指大型城镇，与town相比规模更大
形容天气、情况或体验非常不好
作动词时表示下雨，作名词时指雨水
指去某个地方或拜访某人
英式英语常用，美语也用movie
用于肯定句中，表示动作已经发生
表示否定，意思是at no time in the past or present
指某地区的天气状况，注意与climate（气候）区别
all the time表示一直、总是
专有名词，法国最大的城市和首都

phrases.usage: 用来询问对方是否刚去过某个地方

examples.en: Have you just been to the cinema?

phrases.usage: 用来询问正在上映什么电影或上演什么节目

examples.en: What's on at the cinema tonight?

phrases.usage: 表示已经完成某事，already常与现在完成时连用

examples.en: I've already finished my homework.
Flowers bloom in the spring.
It rained all the time during our trip.
examples.zh: 我们旅行期间一直下雨。

phrases.usage: 表示...也一样，用于比较两者相同

examples.en: The weather here is terrible, just like London.
examples.zh: 这里天气很差，就像伦敦一样。

phrases.usage: 用来询问对方是否曾经去过某地

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?

phrases.usage: 表示在四月，月份前用介词in

examples.en: My birthday is in April.

phrases.usage: 表示一部老电影，old描述film的特征

examples.en: This is an old film from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 这是一部六十年代的老电影。

examples.en: I was there last summer.

sentences.en: Have you just been to the cinema?
I saw it on television last year.
It's an old film, but it's very good.
sentences.zh: 那是一部老电影，但非常好。
巴黎是一座美丽的城市。

sentences.en: Have you ever been there, Ken?
It was spring, but the weather was awful.
sentences.zh: 那是春天，但天气很糟糕。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作或状态与现在有联系，或强调动作的结果。它由have/has + 过去分词构成。
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去发生并持续到现在的情况，或表示过去的动作对现在的影响。本课中Have you just been to...?使用just表示刚刚发生。

examples.en: Have you just been to the cinema?
Yes, I have.
I've already seen it.

grammar.title: 现在完成时与一般过去时的区别
grammar.definition: 现在完成时强调与现在的联系，不明确指出动作发生的时间；一般过去时明确指出过去的时间，适用于具体的时间状语。
grammar.structure: 现在完成时: have/has + 过去分词；一般过去时: 主语 + 过去式
grammar.usage: 当有时间状语明确指出过去时间时，用一般过去时；当不强调时间或与现在有关联时，用现在完成时。本课中I was there in April用一般过去时，因为有具体时间April。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris? (不强调具体时间)
I was there in April. (有具体时间April)
I saw it on television last year. (有具体时间last year)

grammar.title: Have you ever...? 句型
grammar.definition: Have you ever...? 用来询问某人是否曾经有过某种经历。ever意为“在任何时候；曾经”。
grammar.structure: Have/Has + 主语 + ever + 过去分词?
grammar.usage: 用于询问经历，答案可用Yes, I have. / No, I've never...等回答

examples.en: Have you ever been to Paris?
Yes, I have.
No, I've never been there.

patterns.pattern: Have you just been to + 地点?

original.en: Have you just been to the cinema?

examples.en: Have you just been to the shop?
Have you just been to the park?
I've already finished my work.
I've already had breakfast.

patterns.pattern: Have you ever been to + 地点?

original.en: Have you ever been to Paris?

examples.en: Have you ever been to London?
Have you ever been to Tokyo?
It snowed all the time.
It was hot all the time.
